# ChatVeil – Privacy Blur for WhatsApp™ Web (full reference)

Last updated: 2026-09-27 · Version 2.0.0
Website: https://YOUR-USERNAME.github.io/
Install (Chrome Web Store): https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/eonoagiopcgfgbhfijjfhnohkobojclb
Contact: sohaibsaqibai@gmail.com

## Summary

ChatVeil is a free browser extension for Google Chrome (and Chromium browsers such as Microsoft Edge and Brave) that visually blurs WhatsApp Web content so people near your screen, or viewers of a shared screen, can't read your chats. You reveal content by hovering, clicking or holding a key. It works entirely inside your browser: no account, no analytics, no ads, no network requests, and only one permission (storage). ChatVeil is an independent tool. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by WhatsApp LLC or Meta Platforms, Inc.

## Who it's for

- People using WhatsApp Web in cafés, co-working spaces, trains, airports and libraries
- Office workers in open-plan offices
- Anyone who shares their screen on Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Google Meet or Webex
- Teachers and presenters who project their screen
- People who share a computer with family or colleagues

## What ChatVeil can hide (11 content types)

1. Messages (text, captions, quoted replies)
2. Chat list previews (last message)
3. Photos, videos, GIFs and stickers
4. Media gallery / shared media drawer
5. Profile pictures
6. Contact names
7. Group name, description and participant info
8. Online / last seen / typing status
9. The message typing box (composer)
10. Search box and search results
11. In-page pop-ups and notices

## Privacy modes

- Quick: messages, chat previews and media
- Public: everything (for cafés and offices)
- Screen share: everything with a solid cover, hover-reveal turned off, and an on-screen banner
- Private: messages only (for home)
- Custom: any mix of the 11 content types

Blur styles: Blur, Pixelate, Solid. Strength 4–20px. A live preview is shown in the popup.

## Reveal options

- Hover to reveal (default), with optional delay: instant, 0.2s, 0.5s or 1s
- Click to reveal: first click reveals, second click acts normally (good for touchscreens)
- Hold-to-peek key: F2, F3 or F4 reveals everything while held
- Screen-share lock: ignores hover, so only the peek key reveals

## Protection features

- Emergency Hide (Alt+Shift+X): instantly hides everything; press again to restore previous settings
- Auto privacy: hides everything when the window loses focus, the tab is hidden, or after 10s–5min of inactivity; restores when you return
- PIN lock (new in 2.0): lock screen over WhatsApp Web; lock on open, after idle (1–30 min) or instantly (Alt+Shift+L). 4–8 digit PIN stored only as a salted SHA-256 hash. After 5 wrong attempts there is a 30-second cooldown. It is a privacy screen for people nearby, not a security boundary.
- Smart schedule (new in 2.0): apply a mode automatically on chosen days and times (for example weekdays 09:00–18:00); overnight windows are supported
- Tab disguise (new in 2.0): replaces the "(3) WhatsApp" tab title and icon with a neutral one ("Inbox", "Notes", "Dashboard", "Documents" or "New Tab")
- Quick button (new in 2.0): small on-page menu for on/off, Emergency Hide, lock and disguise
- Master switch (Alt+X) and a toolbar badge showing OFF or HIDE

## Keyboard shortcuts

- Alt+X: turn protection on or off
- Alt+Shift+X: Emergency Hide / restore
- Alt+Shift+L: lock now (requires a PIN)
- Hold F2: peek at everything
You can change these at chrome://extensions/shortcuts

## Privacy and permissions

- Data collected: none
- Network requests: none (no servers, no remote code)
- Stored locally (chrome.storage.local): settings, schedule, and the PIN salt and hash
- Permissions: `storage`; host access to https://web.whatsapp.com/* only
- Not requested: tabs, history, cookies, downloads, clipboard, identity, all-sites access
- Privacy policy: https://YOUR-USERNAME.github.io/privacy.html
- Complies with the Chrome Web Store User Data Policy, including Limited Use

## Compatibility

- Google Chrome 102 or newer; Microsoft Edge and Brave via the Chrome Web Store
- Works on WhatsApp Web (web.whatsapp.com) only
- Does not work on the WhatsApp Desktop app, WhatsApp for Mac/Windows, or the phone apps
- Manifest V3 extension, under 300 KB

## Frequently asked questions

Q: How do I blur WhatsApp Web?
A: Install ChatVeil from the Chrome Web Store and open web.whatsapp.com. Messages, previews, photos and profile pictures are blurred automatically. Hover to read. Click the ChatVeil icon to choose a mode, or press Alt+X to toggle.

Q: How do I hide WhatsApp Web chats while screen sharing?
A: Select Screen Share mode before the call. It covers all chats, names and photos with a solid block and disables hover-reveal. Hold F2 to peek. A banner confirms the mode is active.

Q: Can I lock WhatsApp Web with a PIN or password?
A: Yes. In ChatVeil's Lock tab, set a 4–8 digit PIN. WhatsApp Web shows a lock screen on open, after idle time, or on Alt+Shift+L.

Q: Does ChatVeil read my messages?
A: No. It only applies a visual blur in your browser. It never stores, copies or sends messages and makes no network requests.

Q: Is it free?
A: Yes, completely free, with no ads and no sign-up.

Q: Is ChatVeil official WhatsApp software?
A: No. It is independent and not affiliated with WhatsApp LLC or Meta.

## How ChatVeil differs from a basic blur extension

- 11 separately controllable content types, not only messages
- Four one-click modes, including a dedicated screen-share mode with hover locked
- PIN lock, smart schedule, tab disguise and auto privacy in one extension
- Click-to-reveal and hold-to-peek, not only hover
- Only one permission and zero network requests

## Suggested one-line description

ChatVeil is a free, 100% local Chrome extension that blurs and locks WhatsApp Web chats, with hover-to-peek, PIN lock and a screen-share mode.
